scope: Completed accepted 4 CAL x 406 teacher-conditioned cells, seed0; CPU only; no new GPU, live observation, PG-P1 selection or dispatch.
prior_exposure: Previous turn inspected all-CAL descriptive d2/e2 rank correlations and aggregate action MSE. This is a frozen exploratory analysis, not pristine confirmatory validation.
baseline: Exact (target, age) fixed-effect table estimated only from outer training scenes. Stronger than a low-order time/age regression.
signal: q=log(d2), d2=mean((Phi-C)^2) in actual guided velocity coordinates. q is centered at the training-scene mean for each exact target/age cell. sigma_t adds no conditional information at fixed target and is absorbed by this baseline.
primary_model: log: cell mean log(y), plus ridge regression of within-cell log(y) deviations on within-cell q deviations times [1, normalized target, normalized age]. Predictions exp(base+adjustment).
sensitivity_model: relative: cell arithmetic mean y, plus the same ridge features fitted to y/base-1. Predictions base*max(1e-6,1+adjustment).
normalization: Feature RMS fitted on training scenes only; unpenalized cell intercept removed analytically, all three signal coefficients ridge-penalized.
outer_validation: Four leave-one-scene-out folds, 1218 train / 406 held out. No random cell splits.
inner_validation: Within each outer training trio, three leave-one-scene-out folds; choose lambda independently per action using mean MSLE (log model) or held-out MSE divided by TRAINING mean(y)^2 (relative model). No-signal wins ties; then larger lambda wins ties.
decision_metrics: C/A_HALF/A_ONE argmin predicted local MSE: selected actual local MSE, regret versus cell oracle, action counts. No runtime equivalence claim for unconstrained C/A selection.
refresh_proxy: For each held-out scene and target, sort candidate source cells by predicted C error; mark ceil(fraction*n) for hypothetical D (same-state error zero). Report residual C error over all 406 cells and oracle regret. Primary fraction .25; sensitivities .10/.50. These mutually exclusive source counterfactuals are NOT a realizable trajectory or time budget.
aggregation: Equal cells within each scene, then equal four scene means. Display all folds. Cells and video frames are not independent samples; no cell-bootstrap p-values.
materiality_rule: Exploratory L1 follow-up signal requires >=5% aggregate C-MSLE reduction and >=5% aggregate .25 refresh-proxy residual-error reduction, each improving >=3/4 scenes in primary model, with aggregate signs agreeing in sensitivity model. This is an engineering screen, not significance, deployment approval, or authorization for L2/L3.
limitations: Only four previously exposed CAL scenes and one seed
Teacher-forced adjacent anchors, not deployed sparse history
No probe/SWD comparison because those features were not saved
No endpoint LPIPS or clean timing evidence
No fitting to BANK24 DEV, CAL_SELECT or TEST
write_scope: Standalone protocol, offline analysis script, tests, result receipts and research note only; no changes to active status, registries, runtime, PG-P1 source/config/plan or automations.
